summary: Line runs across a main-road junction and painted island; nowhere to stop.
reasons: No parked cars on this stretch

drivers.seclusion: Open, busy junction in a commercial strip; nearest home 23 m but exposure is total.
drivers.access_and_room: Line sits on a chevron island and traffic lanes; no clear room to pull out of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Multi-lane arterial junction with heavy traffic and noise.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along this stretch; parked cars are only on the side street and in car parks.

sun_shade: Open to sky; trees shade the side street to the west.
